steps.content: The Apostle that turns fantasy into reality is gone, but the sea of stars has not yet vanished. A small stage gradually forms from the hail of flowers left behind by Stella.
After battles and separations of life and death, the lions are back together.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: ...Lions?

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: ...Whoa!

Before she can finish talking, someone hammers her head, bringing tears to her eyes. The one who beat her is the dark red lion, who is the largest of the bunch. It swings a blow without even taking off its lion's head.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Whoa whoa whoa! Why you bullying me!
The black and gold lions stare blankly for a while. The dark red lion turns and leaves without saying a word.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Ahh, wait... Oof!
OwO wants to catch up, but she slips and falls into the red lion's arms. She takes off her lion's head, revealing the unique but familiar clothes underneath.

steps.speaker: Red Lion
steps.content: Hey! You're dressed up like a lion, too! Are you also from Goldionville, kid?

steps.speaker: Red Lion
steps.content: It brings tears to my eyes to meet a fellow lion! We've sailed all the way across the sea to DisCity from Gold... uh, Gold-lions-ville!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Goldionville...? But they said that Goldionville already...

steps.speaker: Red Lion
steps.content: <size=28>Oh right, it's Goldionville...</size> Ahem! My naive child! Folks from Goldionville are all gifted geniuses! If we could bring you all the way here in the first place, of course we can also flee the Apocalypse! O ho ho!

steps.speaker: Red Lion
steps.content: But let's talk about that later. I see you're hungry. How about a red bean bun?

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Huh?

Dazed by the red lion's rambling, OwO gets a bun stuffed into her mouth before she gets a chance to respond. It's not a red bean bun, but it tastes exactly like another kind of bun that she had eaten as a child.
You mean BBQ pork bun. <size=28>Sigh... You had so few lines yet you still messed them up.</size>
A green lion walks over with a couple of bamboo steamers in her hands.

steps.speaker: Green Lion
steps.content: We also have chicken, beef, and many other dim sum dishes... all fresh steamed. We also brought chopsticks, if you know how to use them.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content:
Ooo... Ooooo?
(You know how to make Goldionville dim sum?)

steps.speaker: Green Lion
steps.content: I don't cook... These are from DisCity.

steps.speaker: Green Lion
steps.content: <size=30>We ordered take-out from a famous restaurant in Eastside called Fulong. It's really popular, and it even got featured by the famous food blog "Creme Brulee." Supposedly it's a family business that had been passed down for many generations. Its founder is also an Outlander.</size>

steps.speaker: Green Lion
steps.content: Just like you.
Behind them, a girl's scattered mumbles can be heard.
<size=28>I really like your movie... I wanted to... meet you...</size>

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Lynn?
Ahhh! No no, you've got the wrong person! I-I'm also just someone passing by DisCity.
She covers her face with the envelope, then hands the envelope to OwO with trembling hands.

steps.speaker: Pink Lion
steps.content: ...Someone asked me to tell you... that after his granny watched your vlog, she thought of her own granny... That granny really wants to meet you... She...

steps.speaker: Pink Lion
steps.content: Th-this is really the first time meeting you. I'm not good at memoriz... I mean, talking. But people really did watch your vlog and see your lion dance!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: ...Mmm... Ah, got it!
OwO doesn't ask any more questions, but just flashes a big smile to everyone.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Thank you for coming so far to see me, and for telling me so many interesting things. I'm really, really happy!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Um, can you tell me more about Goldionville? I want to hear everything!

steps.speaker: Pink Lion
steps.content: Oh... sure! I'll tell you everything I know!

They tell her about everything... about the steamers of delicious food, about the different decorations on their clothes, about the hardworking immigrants scattered across this city, and about the fragmented memories of their distant homeland.

<size=30>The three lions talk nonstop, at times making vivid descriptions, but also blurring the details sometimes, as if there are gaping holes in their memories. OwO, however, listens to everything with relish. All her pain is gone, and now she is giggling the whole way through.</size>
The dark red lion sits alone in a quiet corner and looks at its hidden watch. Time really flies. It's been 102 minutes since the reunion started.
Things are about to end. As it gets ready to leave, the girl suddenly hugs it from behind.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: I caught you!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: What, want to beat me up again? Hehe, I'm full from yummy food now! You can't catch me anymore! Plus, everyone told me that you were just throwing a tantrum because you're mad at yourself!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: You wanted to be in the final battle with me, but then couldn't keep up with my speed on the way there. You saw me going ahead to challenge Stella's family alone and got frustrated.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Don't be mad. I ran fast because my mighty lion's soul awakened. I was amazing! Don't worry, I won with flying colors! I didn't embarrass you at all. Praise me, praise me...
The dark red lion doesn't want to argue, so it just pats her on the head. She snuggles its palm happily.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Hehe... Also, I heard that the most authentic lion dance in Goldionville requires two people to perform together, but I've always been doing it alone.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Can you teach me?
The dark red lion pauses, then picks up OwO by the armpits and holds her up. The girl giggles.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Hahahaha, that was terrible! No no, let's try it again! Hee-yah...
She gets lifted up again, and laughs even more gleefully. Out of the corner of her eye, she notices a row of uniformed ducks on the other side of the stars looking back at her.
They give a salute and vanish.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Ahh...
The dark red lion also saw them. It puts OwO down and takes a few breaths, as if wanting to say something. OwO hurriedly grabs the corner of its clothes.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: ...Don't go, I still have a wish. The last one...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: It took you so long to get here. Chat with me for a bit, okay?

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: I made an awesome movie. The hero went through many hardships and dangers, but finally succeeds thanks to everyone's help and gets a big happy ending.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Though it won't get a DisCar, it helped me bring my friend home. I realized my wish. I really love this movie, and I've been wanting to show it to you guys.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Can you stay with me to watch the ending?
The dark red lion goes quiet for a while. Time is running out. But the girl is pleading so earnestly, so in the end...
You sit down.
The bright stars begin to fade, and the gleeful chatter gradually dissipates. The vast void slowly dims, the lights come on, and you return to a quiet theater.
At last, the dark red lion's head also vanishes. OwO sees your face, but isn't surprised at all.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: It's fine... It's fine...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: It's a movie, after all... I knew it was fake all along. But... why do I still like it so much? I know it's all fake, yet I still believe everything!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: I believe that all the lions are super powerful and invincible against the Apocalypse. I believe that I still have compatriots around me, and that some of them have seen me and my lion dance!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: I don't believe that my hometown is gone anymore. Even after the movie ends, Goldionville must still be around. Someday, I will go back to find it.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: I'm so happy that my movie got the best ending ever!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: This is exactly the kind of movie I wanted to watch. What is it called again? The thing you like most...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: ...Dazzling fantasy!
...Mmm, let's end it here.

steps.speaker: [Black Out]
steps.content: The camera holder reviews her work and is about to turn off the camera when someone walks into the frame in front of her.
...Huh? How come you're here?
Look... A Sinner was just born here, and a really strong one at that. So quit bothering me and go do your work, MBCC Chief.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Isn't there an outstanding Sinner here, too?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: <size=30>To have the same kind of power as the Apostle... Creating mutations on such a large scale, neutralizing the Mania field, producing illusions so powerful that the real is indistinguishable from the fake, and even constraining the Apostle of Ashes... This is S-Class power.</size>

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You're still good at concealing yourself as usual.
Hehe, you want to catch me? Even the Dillywood paparazzi can't do that. I suggest you give up.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...I'm here to thank you, Director Deren.

steps.speaker: Deren
steps.content: Tracy
steps.female_content: ...You're welcome, Miss Clapper. Your acting was good, too.

steps.speaker: Option
options: The brilliant script is written by Director Deren, after all.

steps.content: I also got personal, night-long instruction from you... The filming equipment for My Best Cool Car and all that Dillywood press coverage were your doing too, right? Only you would and can do those things.

steps.speaker: Deren
steps.content: Hehe... You're right. I had to secretly pull all those all-nighters instructing you while doing Outland research. That really tired me out.

steps.speaker: Deren
steps.content: I gotta hit the road now. My disguise for the past couple of years has been busted. I don't want those Dillywood people coming after me again.

steps.speaker: Deren
steps.content: I'll hand over what I've filmed to you. Though I can't add in my "special effects," all the most precious things are in there. It's more than enough to win a small prize and make a child happy.
You take over the cellphone that had been recording the vlogs all this time. You don't need to look at it to know that it's filled with the girl's happy, smiling face.

steps.speaker: Option
options: She'd be happier if she could thank you in person.

steps.speaker: Deren
steps.content: ...I should be the one saying thanks.

steps.speaker: Deren
steps.content: It's been a long time since I've picked up a camera. I was finally able to film an interesting movie that I myself wanted to make.
She turns to leave.

steps.speaker: Deren
steps.content: It's alright. The director should be someone who works behind the scenes.

steps.speaker: Deren
steps.content: Next time you have a good plan, I'll be back.

After the whole ordeal, the 41st DisCars Awards Ceremony was postponed but ultimately held.
However, media coverage about the disappearance of Director Deren overshadowed the ceremony itself. After being pursued by multiple parties for breach of contract fees, the Dean of DisCity Film Academy finally resigned from the pressure.

It has been confirmed that during the battle against the Apostle of Ashes, OwO awakened as an S-Class Sinner. At the behest of Chief ${PlayerName}, OwO agreed to return to the Bureau, and was picked up by a Bureau vehicle disguised as a filming car.
However, after receiving a letter from the Outlands, the Sinner escaped from the vehicle and disappeared after leaving a message.

"The folks from Goldionville wrote to me! They saw me! I'm gonna go home right now and read their letter. Be back in a jiffy! ${PlayerName}, I'm leaving the film's post-production and distribution work to you. You're My Best Cool Car's trusty clapper, after all!"
